problems.title: Swap a conjunction
problems.statement: (p q : Prop) : p ∧ q → q ∧ p

problems.title: Swap a disjunction
problems.statement: (p q : Prop) : p ∨ q → q ∨ p
problems.reference_proof:
intro h
cases h with
| inl hp => exact Or.inr hp
| inr hq => exact Or.inl hq

problems.title: Compose implications
problems.statement: (p q r : Prop) : (p → q) → (q → r) → p → r
problems.reference_proof:
intro hpq hqr hp
exact hqr (hpq hp)

problems.title: Contradict a conjunction
problems.reference_proof:
intro h hpq
exact h hpq.1 hpq.2

problems.title: Swap existential witnesses
problems.statement: (α β : Type) (r : α → β → Prop) : (∃ a, ∃ b, r a b) → ∃ b, ∃ a, r a b
problems.reference_proof:
intro h
rcases h with ⟨a, b, hab⟩
exact ⟨b, a, hab⟩

problems.title: Distribute universal conjunction
problems.statement: (α : Type) (p q : α → Prop) : (∀ x, p x ∧ q x) → (∀ x, p x) ∧ (∀ x, q x)
problems.reference_proof:
intro h
constructor
· intro x
  exact (h x).1
· intro x
  exact (h x).2

problems.title: Addition by zero on the right
Addition commutes
problems.statement: (a b : Nat) : a + b = b + a

problems.title: Successor preserves distinctness
problems.statement: (a b : Nat) : Nat.succ a = Nat.succ b → a = b

problems.title: Length of concatenation
problems.statement: (α : Type) (xs ys : List α) : (xs ++ ys).length = xs.length + ys.length
problems.reference_proof:
induction xs with
| nil => simp
| cons x xs ih => simp [List.length, List.append, ih, Nat.succ_add]

problems.title: Mapping identity over a list
problems.statement: (α : Type) (xs : List α) : xs.map (fun x => x) = xs
problems.reference_proof:
induction xs with
| nil => rfl
| cons x xs ih => simp [List.map, ih]
